title: The scanner matches line-by-line, so a promisified sleep split across lines (ne…
body: The scanner matches line-by-line, so a promisified sleep split across lines (new Promise(resolve =>\n setTimeout(resolve, 100))) would evade detection. Acceptable as a lint heuristic mirroring check-debt-markers, but worth a comment noting the single-line assumption.

body: The US-006 patterns.md bullet uses em-dash characters while the sibling US-001..US-005 bullets consistently use '--'. Minor stylistic inconsistency; the file already contains em-dashes on main so it is non-blocking.
